title: Markdown Front Matter Generic Schema
description: The YAML block between --- lines at the top of a Markdown file, as static site generators (Jekyll, Hugo, MkDocs, Docusaurus) read it: the common keys with their usual types; any other key is allowed. Written for PyMagic.

description.description: A short summary of the page.

date.description: When the page was written (YAML reads 2026-11-04 as a date).

draft.description: A draft is left out of the built site.

weight.description: The page's place in a menu or list.
